    """Replay a verified key/coordinate route, stopping if the game terminates."""

            return
        if isinstance(action, tuple):
            env.step(*action)
        else:
            env.step(action)

    follow_action_sequence(env, route)

item.text: The corrected tile view shows color 5 is traversable space: the pair moved into it, while the large color-6/7 structures are the true regional barriers. The other colored pieces sit in strategically narrow passages. I’m using the observed color-10 positions as the search key now; this reduces the navigation search from raw animation frames to at most a few hundred meaningful pair states.

A context probe reveals the core mechanic: moving onto the lower color-15 single removes that key plus all three color-15 barrier bars, while leaving the distant color-15 key. So progress is the count of remaining keyed barrier cells, not mere movement. I’m now searching over `(pair positions, remaining color-12/14/15 pieces)`, which preserves those irreversible gate-clear events.
